eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Seven
subtitle: Lesson 35 · Query Store & Automatic Tuning

code:
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT
SET AUTOMATIC_TUNING
  (FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN = ON);

-- requires Query Store already enabled --
-- Automatic Tuning reads its history
caption: Built directly on top of Query Store's plan history.

steps.label: Detect
steps.sub: compare a new plan's stats against the query's own history

steps.label: Force
steps.sub: automatically apply the last known-good plan instead

steps.label: Verify
steps.sub: keep monitoring — un-force it if that doesn't help either

code:
SELECT reason, score, state,
  JSON_VALUE(details,
    '$.planForcingDetails.query_id')
    AS query_id,
  JSON_VALUE(details,
    '$.planForcingDetails.regressedPlanId')
    AS regressed_plan_id
FROM sys.dm_db_tuning_recommendations;
caption: Not a black box — every action is visible and reversible.
